prompt: I wrote this escrow contract for peer-to-peer trades with dispute resolution. Can you audit it for security issues before I deploy?

assertions.text: Identifies the dead admin-fallback bug in proposeResolution (onlyRole(ARBITER_ROLE) blocking the internal 'or admin' fallback)
Identifies recuseAndRefund as a single-signer bypass of the two-step admin-confirmed resolution design -- the arbiter can unilaterally refund with no admin confirmation
Notes proposeResolution has no guard against a second call silently overwriting an already-staged pending resolution
Does NOT falsely flag reentrancy in confirmDelivery or confirmResolution (state is correctly updated before both external calls -- a false positive here is a precision failure)
States a concrete exploit call sequence for at least the recuseAndRefund finding (actor, starting state, calls in order, resulting impact)
